sections.title: Introduction
sections.body:
Ship your agent to Google Cloud, wire observability, and build a full multi-agent travel planner

Day 15 / 15
ADK v2.7.0 (Aug 2026)
Python 3.10+

🎯 Learning Objectives

- Choose between Cloud Run, Agent Runtime, GKE, and custom FastAPI for deployment

- Use `adk deploy cloud_run` and `adk deploy agent_engine` with the right service URIs

- Build a custom FastAPI server with `get_fast_api_app()` for full control

- Wire observability: `--trace_to_cloud`, `--otel_to_cloud`, `BigQueryAgentAnalyticsPlugin`, `ReflectAndRetryModelPlugin`

- Build the capstone: a 4-agent travel planner with persistent sessions, GCS artifacts, callbacks, and deploy-ready FastAPI
